XData.Data:
<style type="text/css">

	background: #C5D6D6;
	color: black;
	font-family: Verdana;

}

#txtPassword {
	position: absolute;

#lblInfo {

    background: yellow;
 	font-style: italic;
}

}
#lblAccess {

XData.name: Contents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this page.
XData.Data:
<page xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" title="Interface Team Login" width="100%"> <hgroup width="98%" align="center"> <image id="TemplateLogo" align="left" width="150"/> <label id="title" value="Interface Team - Source Control / Deployment" align="left"/> </hgroup> <cssGroup> <!-- put page contents here --> <combobox id="comboboxFunction" editable="false" dropdownHeight="50" selectedIndex="1"> <option value="srcCtrl" text="Source Control"/> <option value="deploy" text="Deployment"/> </combobox>
<label id="lblUsername" value="Username" /> <text id="txtUsername" />
<label id ="lblPassword" value="Password" /> <password id="txtPassword" name="passwd" required="true" /> <label id ="lblInfo" value="Valid LDAP Username/Password" />
<button id="buttonLogin" caption="Login" onclick="zenPage.validateFields();" /> <label id="lblAccess" value="Access Denied" hidden="true" enclosingClass="badLabel" /> </cssGroup> </page>
